$comment: Type-perf budget (deterministic tsc metrics). Regenerate with `bun run scripts/type-budget.ts --update` and review the diff — never hand-edit. Gate: instantiations >10% over budget fails CI. NOTE: a package target measures its OWN tsconfig, which includes its type tests — packages/questpie jumped +7.9% on 2026-07-29 purely from adding test/types/field-inference.test-d.ts (286,129 instantiations for that one file; removing it returns the number to baseline exactly). Test cost is not framework cost and users never typecheck our tests, so when this target moves, check whether a test file was added before hunting a regression. The three example targets are the user-facing signal.
